name: scott-claude-plugins
description: Personal plugins for Claude. Each plugin's description states which surface it needs: Cowork, Claude Code, or both.

plugins.name: flywheel
plugins.description: Claude Code only. Runs a repo's issue loop, from an approved issue to a merged pull request, through desktop sessions that each play one role. This version installs the script, the roles file and the review and merge policies, ships the docs that define the method the loop follows, carries the queue and claim lock that keep two sessions off one issue, files an issue or a plan of issues through its file-issue skill, assesses and records which of the method's controls a repo holds through its adopt skill, ships the hook that keeps the approved label for the owner, and has the dispatcher's run skill, the implementer's work-issue skill and the reviewer's review-pr skill. The dispatcher merges a pull request when the merge policy lets it flow, and asks the owner about the rest. It measures each merged pull request's spend, first-pass CI, review findings and lead time, and ships a scheduled workflow that reports them in an issue.

plugins.name: gitify-cowork-project
plugins.description: Cowork only. Puts an existing Cowork Project folder under git without touching its documents: commit helpers, and a CLAUDE.md holding the Project Instructions and how Claude commits and reads the history.

plugins.name: prose-tuning
plugins.description: Claude Code and Cowork. Learns a project's house prose style from edits already made, records it as prose-style.md with stable rule ids, and conforms the rest of the documents to it.

plugins.name: todos
plugins.description: Claude Code only. Files the TODO comments left in a project's uncommitted changes as GitHub issues, or hands one to an installed skill made for its work, after the author approves every draft, and marks each one in its file with where it went.
